summary: Reviewed mcp-server/tests/gui/api.test.ts and mcp-server/tests/storage/ledger-store.test.ts. All 6 acceptance criteria verified through direct source inspection.

handleRenameProject: 7 cases cover success (including last_updated timestamp assertion), Zod min/max boundaries (empty, 201-char, 200-char boundary), NOT_FOUND for ghost slug, path-traversal slugs ('../escape', 'a/b', ''), persistence round-trip via handleGetProject, and an extra non-object body case.
repository_name test constructs a depth-4 plan_path (tmpdir/my-repo/docs/agents/plans/...) and asserts 'my-repo' — validates the full inferProjectRootFromPlanPath chain end-to-end.

LedgerStore.updateTitle unit tests use isolated beforeEach/afterEach tempdir, raw JSON disk-read for persistence verification, and ISO string comparison for timestamp checks — all idiomatic and correctly isolated.
Title priority tests chain createProject() + store.updateTitle() cleanly, verifying both the override path and the fallback-to-slug path.
Suite total: 1093 tests across 36 files, 0 failures, 0 TypeScript errors. No regressions introduced.

comments.note: The boundary test at exactly 200 chars is an important inclusion — it confirms the Zod max(200) constraint is inclusive, not exclusive.
The ISO string timestamp comparison (result.last_updated >= before) works correctly because ISO 8601 strings sort lexicographically in temporal order. Clean idiomatic pattern for this test layer.
Persistence test reads raw JSON from disk rather than using the API to verify — correctly isolates the storage layer from the handler layer.
The non-object body test case ('not-an-object') goes beyond the stated ACs, providing extra confidence that the Zod safeParse guard handles unexpected input types, not just wrong field values.
